low_characteristics.str: Struggles to lift, push, oppose Strength Tests; unopposed Strength Tests take twice as long; gains Fatigue on failed opposed Strength Tests.
low_characteristics.tou: Staggers when making Toughness Tests against negative effects.
low_characteristics.agi: Must pass +15 Agility Test to Run or Sprint or fall Prone; cannot use Agility for Stunt.
low_characteristics.wfr: Cannot make Called Shots or Aim Actions with ranged weapons.
low_characteristics.wfm: Cannot make Called Shots or Aim Actions with melee weapons.
low_characteristics.int: Takes twice as long to solve problems even on successful Tests.
low_characteristics.per: Cannot judge direction or distance of sounds; struggles to see beyond Perceptive Range.
low_characteristics.crg: Flees for first Half Action when scared.
low_characteristics.cha: Takes double time to speak or respond; struggles to understand speech.
low_characteristics.ldr: Takes twice as long to give orders; takes a Full Action to understand orders.
